evaluate_expression_js_handle: evaluate a JavaScript expression using a JSHandle and serialize arguments
serialize_python_value_handles: serialize Python values including JSHandles, datetime, exceptions, and typed arrays for Playwright
parse_playwright_result_value: parse Playwright result values back to Python objects including typed arrays and errors
get_js_handle_properties: get property or all properties from a JSHandle as nested JSHandles
add_source_url_to_script: append a sourceURL comment to JavaScript source code for debugging
